summary: Query-expansion transparency: surface matched family/domain to N concepts using match_tier

resolution.test_function: POST /api/query — surfaces query expansion in the X-Query-Expansion header
resolution.note: New summarizeExpansion() (graph.ts) returns family/domain matches + concept counts; /api/query runs it in parallel with retrieve and emits a URI-encoded X-Query-Expansion header (omitted when nothing expanded); chat-view parses it and renders a chip per match ('↳ Cosmology → 7 concepts'). Concept-tier 1:1 matches excluded. Tests: graph.test (3) + api.test (2) added; full suite 376 pass, lint+type-check green. Visible behaviour lights up once the v3 corpus is loaded (validated at GATE-A/B), like the rest of the query change.
